narrative.overview: A direct, capable trade-service identity carried forward from the supplied Ryde site: condensed headlines, generous real photography, warm paper, navy foundations and vivid blue wayfinding. Red marks the phone action. Space and strong type make practical advice easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed display type with Chicago-style title capitalization and open, readable body copy.
Square controls and flat, rule-separated content.
Actual team, equipment and drainage photography.
Prominent telephone actions across desktop and mobile.

rules.name: The Call Color Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to telephone actions; informational actions use blue or underlined text.

rules.name: The Heading Contrast Rule
rules.body: Reserve all-uppercase treatment for the homepage hero and brand; ordinary headings use Chicago-style title capitalization.

rules.name: The Bounded Layout Rule
rules.body: Keep primary content inside an 1180px frame with 32px desktop and 18px mobile gutters; full-width color fields may extend to the viewport while their content remains bounded.

dos: Do preserve the navy, blue, paper and red family identity.
Do use real supplied work imagery, descriptive alt text and accurate captions.
Do keep telephone actions prominent and explain booking availability in plain language.
Do preserve keyboard access, visible focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't turn service tiles into rounded, shadowed dashboard cards.
Don't invent job locations, review metrics or guarantees to decorate the interface.
Don't apply the hero's uppercase treatment to every heading.
Don't introduce decorative motion or autoplay media.
